provenance.l: Tianwen-1 / Zhurong EDL — entry at 125 km and 4.8 km/s, ~460 m/s at parachute deploy, about nine minutes to touchdown (Spaceflight Now); entry angle and chute altitude fitted to the nine minutes (the model deploys at ~430 m/s)
Zhurong (rover) — landed 14 May 2021; drove down the ramp onto the surface on 22 May 2021, about 7 days later (Wikipedia). The ramp-deploy time is not sourced.

Tianwen-1 as researched for pass 2 (docs/wip/2026-11-23-mars-landings-record.md, secondary sources): shell and chute off about 1.5 km; a variable-thrust engine; hover at about 100 m for hazard avoidance (10 s drawn, an estimate); four legs; Zhurong down the ramp 7–8 days later (drawn as the ramp_deploy and rover_egress beats; the ramp-deploy moment is an estimate)
